name: Young Lovers

angles.text: As an Alliance member passing through Elwynn, you may carry messages between the feuding Stonefields and Maclures. Even with the kingdom in danger, small heartaches go on.
As a human who knows Elwynn, you have heard of the old grudge between the Stonefields and the Maclures. Maybell and Tommy Joe's romance is a delicate scandal among the neighbors.

faq.answer: Maybell Maclure gives it at the Maclure Vineyards in Elwynn Forest. She loves Tommy Joe Stonefield, but their families are bitter rivals, so they cannot meet openly.
faq.q: Who gives the quest Young Lovers?

faq.answer: Tommy Joe Stonefield waits on the riverbank just west of Stonefield Farm, which lies due west of the Maclure Vineyards. There he stays out of his family's sight.
faq.q: Where can Tommy Joe Stonefield be found?

aliases: why can't maybell and tommy joe see each other
faq.answer: The Stonefields and the Maclures have held a grudge against each other for years. Neither family lets its children mix, so the young couple writes secret letters.
faq.q: Why are Maybell and Tommy Joe kept apart?

aliases: what do you deliver in young lovers
faq.answer: You carry Maybell's Love Letter to Tommy Joe Stonefield at the river. It tells him of her affection and devotion, feud or no feud.
faq.q: What item do you deliver during this quest?

aliases: what happens when you deliver the letter
faq.answer: Tommy Joe is thrilled and calls Maybell the light of his dull life. Her words make being apart more than he can bear, so he begins looking for a way for them to meet.
faq.q: How does Tommy Joe react to the letter?

aliases: where does young lovers take place
faq.answer: The story unfolds in southern Elwynn Forest, between the Maclure Vineyards and the river by Stonefield Farm. This quiet farming corner of the human kingdom is troubled by a petty family quarrel.
faq.q: Where does this quest take place?

sections.body: The Stonefields and the Maclures have held their grudge for years in southern Elwynn's farm country. Maybell cannot visit Tommy Joe without stirring her family's anger. So she trusts travelers to carry her letters across the line between the two farms.
sections.title: A Forbidden Romance

sections.body: Tommy Joe stays beyond his relatives' sight on the quiet riverbank just west of Stonefield Farm. A letter from Maybell brings relief and fresh longing. Being apart grows more than he can bear, and the pair begin seeking ways to meet in secret.
sections.title: The Riverbank Rendezvous

summary: Maybell Maclure loves Tommy Joe Stonefield, though their families are bitter rivals. She asks you to carry her letter to him by the river.
